zh: 吹笛者，傳說中用笛子引走老鼠的人
en: A legendary figure who uses a pipe to lure rats away.
en_example: The Pied Piper of Hamlin led the rats out of the town.
zh_example: 哈姆林的吹笛者引走了鎮上的老鼠。
ja: 笛を吹いてネズミを誘い出す伝説の人物
local: A legendary figure who uses a pipe to lure rats away.
kana: ふえをふいてねずみをさそいだすでんせつのじんぶつ
romaji: Fue o fuite nezumi o sosoidasu densetsu no jinbutsu
ja_example: The Pied Piper of Hamlin led the rats out of the town.
local_example: The Pied Piper of Hamlin led the rats out of the town.

en: A matter or situation regarded as unwelcome or harmful and needing to be dealt with.
en_example: The town of Hamlin had a rat problem.
local: A matter or situation regarded as unwelcome or harmful and needing to be dealt with.
kana: もんだい、こんなんなじょうきょう
ja_example: The town of Hamlin had a rat problem.
local_example: The town of Hamlin had a rat problem.

en_example: The rats were everywhere and I mean everywhere.
zh_example: 老鼠到處都是，我是說真的到處都是。
ja: どこにでも、あらゆる場所に
kana: どこにでも、あらゆるばしょに
romaji: Doko ni demo, arayuru basho ni
ja_example: The rats were everywhere and I mean everywhere.
local_example: The rats were everywhere and I mean everywhere.

ja: 飢えている、非常に空腹な
kana: うえている、ひじょうにくうふくな
romaji: Uete iru, hijou ni kuufuku na

en: Places where grain is stored for future use.
zh_example: 他們毀壞了我的穀物儲藏處！
local: Places where grain is stored for future use.
kana: こくもつをほかんするばしょ

en: Continue to live or exist, especially in spite of danger or hardship.
en_example: If this continues, Hamlin won't survive!
zh_example: 如果這樣持續下去，哈姆林將無法存活！
ja: 生き残る、困難に耐えて存在し続ける
local: Continue to live or exist, especially in spite of danger or hardship.
kana: いきのこる、こんなんにたえてそんざいしつづける
romaji: Ikinokoru, konnan ni taete sonzai shitsuzukeru
ja_example: If this continues, Hamlin won't survive!
local_example: If this continues, Hamlin won't survive!

en: Coins made of gold used as money.
local: Coins made of gold used as money.

en: Give (something, especially money) in order to help achieve or provide something.
en_example: Will you contribute to his payment?
zh_example: 你願意為他的報酬出一份力嗎？
ja: （特にお金を）提供する、貢献する
local: Give (something, especially money) in order to help achieve or provide something.
kana: とくにおかねをていきょうする、こうけんする
romaji: Toku ni okane o teikyō suru, kōken suru
ja_example: Will you contribute to his payment?
local_example: Will you contribute to his payment?

ja: 機能している、意図した通りに動いている
kana: きのうしている、いとしたとおりにうごいている
romaji: Kinou shite iru, ito shita toori ni ugoite iru

en_example: 1,000 gold coins is an absurd amount.
zh_example: 一千枚金幣是個荒謬的數目。
ja_example: 1,000 gold coins is an absurd amount.
local_example: 1,000 gold coins is an absurd amount.

en: A declaration or assurance that one will do something or that a particular thing will happen.
en_example: A promise has value only when it costs something to keep.
zh_example: 承諾只有在付出代價時才有價值。
ja: 約束、何かをするという保証
local: A declaration or assurance that one will do something or that a particular thing will happen.
kana: やくそく、なにかをするというほしょう
romaji: Yakusoku, nanika o suru to iu hoshou
ja_example: A promise has value only when it costs something to keep.
local_example: A promise has value only when it costs something to keep.

en: A moral or legal obligation; a responsibility.
en_example: We have a duty to protect the citizens of Hamlin.
zh_example: 我們有責任保護哈姆林的市民。
local: A moral or legal obligation; a responsibility.
ja_example: We have a duty to protect the citizens of Hamlin.
local_example: We have a duty to protect the citizens of Hamlin.

en: Firm belief in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone or something.
en_example: But trust, once broken, may cost far more than anyone is willing to pay.
zh_example: 但信任一旦破裂，可能付出的代價遠超過任何人願意承擔的。
ja: 信頼、誰かや何かの信憑性に対する確固たる信念
local: Firm belief in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone or something.
kana: しんらい、だれかやなにかのしんぴょうせいにたいするかっこたるしんねん
romaji: Shinrai, dareka ya nanika no shinpyousei ni taisuru kakkotaru shinnen
ja_example: But trust, once broken, may cost far more than anyone is willing to pay.
local_example: But trust, once broken, may cost far more than anyone is willing to pay.
